thread:
incident-bot: Pager: anomaly detected in billing/metering UI (usage counters showing 0 for a subset of tenants). Alert rule: metering_ui_zero_rate. Severity: P2 — paging eng-oncall @simon. See: https://infra.redwood/status/alerts/1798123456 :rotating_light:

simon: on it. I'm looking at ingestion and the cache layer first. any obvious customer impact reported yet?

tara: +1, watching logs and queue lengths. can you check redis TTLs and the streaming worker health? last deploy 3h ago.

kevin: CS reporting a handful of customers seeing invoice preview show 0 usage. no charges posted yet but previews look wrong. customers asking if invoices will be delayed.

simon: initial triage: metering ingestion backlog spiked ~04:10 UTC, a few metering-api pods reporting 503s to ingestion workers. redis key TTLs for prefix "meter:cache" look abnormal (very short). possible config regression in cache eviction.

incident-bot: Update: incident created (INC-2026-metric-display). Pager duty link: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026

simon: mitigation plan: 1) restart metering-api deployment to flush bad cache clients, 2) manually bump TTL for live tenants to 600s, 3) launch recon job to replay 1h window for top tenants. executing step 1 now:```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment metering-api
kubectl -n infra rollout status deployment metering-api -w
```

tara: also going to scale up replay-worker to 4 to shorten recon time. running:```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deployment replay-worker --replicas=4
```

billing: keep CS on hold for billing decisions. don't auto-send any billing emails yet. we'll confirm reconciliation before final invoices.

omar: drafting status-page message — keeping it short and non-technical. proposal: 

"We are investigating an issue affecting the billing dashboard where recent usage may not display correctly for a subset of customers. No invoices have been finalized. Our engineers are working on a fix and we will provide updates within 60 minutes."

simon: recon job started (job id: recon-1798123456). replaying ingestion events 04:00-05:00 UTC for top 50 tenants. sample output tail:```
[INFO] tenant=acme processed 124 events
[WARN] tenant=beta failed to find segment, queued for retry
[INFO] tenant=charlie processed 98 events
```

tara: good. I'm seeing counters start to come back for a handful of tenants after cache bump. UI still shows stale zeros for others — likely eventual as recon finishes. putting a short note on the internal incident doc.

omar: customer-facing blurb for CS email (optional channel):

"Hi — we're currently investigating an issue where usage previews may show zero for some customers. We are actively replaying events to recover accurate usage. No charges will be posted until reconciliation completes. We anticipate updates within 1 hour and will follow up when all previews are corrected. Apologies for the disruption."

billing: confirm: finance will hold any automated invoice generation until recon job completes and we validate. set a flag in billing pipeline: `hold_invoicing=true`.

simon: status update for status.redwood.com (short):

"Partial outage: Billing dashboard UI showing incorrect recent usage for a subset of customers. Engineers investigating. No invoices finalized. Next update: in 30-60 minutes."

incident-bot: Status updated to "investigating" on status.redwood.com by simon.

simon: recon progress: ~60% complete for top 50 tenants; processed ~35 minutes of events in 10 minutes (workers scaled). top 20 tenants validated: counts match expected events.

tara: performing sanity checks: comparing event counts vs reconciled tokens for top tenants. small divergence for tenants with high burst rates; replay will handle. I think we can mark P2 -> maintain until all replays done.

omar: draft internal comms template for CS and AE teams (short):

"Internal: We are investigating a metering UI anomaly causing zeroed usage previews for some customers. Engineers have started event replay and caches have been reset. No invoices have been finalized and finance is holding invoice generation. Suggested CS script: apologize, reassure on no charges, offer ETA for next update (60 minutes), and take contact info for follow-up. Escalate any high-risk customers to billing immediately."

billing: creating a reconciliation ticket for finance to sign off once recon job completes: FIN-RECON-1798123456.

simon: recon done ~95% now. a handful of tenants failed with missing segments — queued for manual rehydrate. I'll run targeted repair for those 6 tenants.

kevin: taking over monitoring as night oncall in 30m. what should I watch for? checklist?

tara: handoff checklist to @kevin: 1) monitor recon job progress and failures, 2) watch status.redwood.com for any scheduled updates, 3) verify billing flag `hold_invoicing` is set and will persist, 4) confirm top 20 tenants validated, 5) contact billing if any discrepancies >0.5% after recon.

kevin: ack — got it. I'll keep the loop and update status page when we have full recovery.

simon: final (for now): cache cleared, recon completed for >99% tenants, manual repairs scheduled for 6 tenants (ETA 3 hours), UI counters are recovering. tagging CS/billing for any customer outreach. will follow up in the incident doc with full timeline and root-cause analysis once postmortem starts. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-metric-display set to "monitoring" by simon.

kevin: closing note: if you get direct customer escalations overnight, escalate to billing immediately and reference FIN-RECON-1798123456. I'll update status page once manual repairs finish.
